```{r, echo=TRUE}
## ==========================================================
## TFCE for between-subject design with covariate in R
##
## Model:
##   Amplitude ~ Covariate + GroupCode
##
## Test:
##   Group effect adjusted for covariate
##
## Permutation:
##   Freedman-Lane
## ==========================================================

rm(list = ls())

library(readr)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(fields)

source("../R/tfce_transform.R")
source("../R/plot_eeg_map.R")

cat("\nStarting TFCE covariate-adjusted analysis...\n")

## ==========================================================
## -1. Load data
## ==========================================================

designTable <- read_csv("../data/02_designTable.csv")
EEGlong     <- read_csv("../data/02_EEGdata_long.csv")

## Check column names
print(names(designTable))
print(names(EEGlong))

## ==========================================================
## 0. Merge EEG data with design table
## ==========================================================

dat <- EEGlong %>%
  left_join(designTable, by = "Subject") %>%
  mutate(
    Subject   = factor(Subject),
    Channel   = factor(Channel),
    CondCode = as.numeric(CondCode),
    Covariate = as.numeric(Covariate)
  )
## Make sure condition is numeric contrast
## Expected:
##   CondCode  = -1 control, +1 treatment

channels <- unique(EEGlong$Channel)
times    <- sort(unique(EEGlong$Time))

nChan <- length(channels)
nTime <- length(times)

## ==========================================================
## -2. Function: compute observed/permuted t-map
## ==========================================================

compute_tmap_covariate <- function(data) {
  res <- data %>%
    group_by(Channel, Time) %>%
    summarise(t_value = coef(summary(lm(
      Amplitude ~ Covariate + CondCode
    )))["CondCode", "t value"], .groups = "drop")
  
  tvec <- res %>%
    mutate(
      Channel = factor(Channel, levels = channels),
      Time    = factor(Time, levels = times)
    ) %>%
    arrange(Channel, Time) %>%
    pull(t_value)
  
  matrix(
    tvec,
    nrow = nChan,
    ncol = nTime,
    byrow = TRUE,
    dimnames = list(channels, times)
  )
}

## ==========================================================
## Step 1: Observed t-map
## ==========================================================

cat("Step 1: Computing observed t-map...\n")

t_Obs <- compute_tmap_covariate(dat)

cat("Observed t-map completed.\n")

## ==========================================================
## Step 2: Observed TFCE map
## ==========================================================

cat("Step 2: Computing observed TFCE map...\n")

TFCE_Obs <- tfce_transform(t_Obs, E  = 0.66, H  = 2, dh = 0.1)

cat("Observed TFCE map completed.\n")

## ==========================================================
## Step 3: Freedman-Lane permutation
## ==========================================================

set.seed(123)

nPerm <- 999
TFCE_permMax <- rep(NA_real_, nPerm)

cat("Step 3: Starting Freedman-Lane permutation testing...\n")

## ==========================================================
## Precompute reduced-model fitted values and residuals
## This is done once, before permutation
## ==========================================================

FL_parts <- dat %>%
  group_by(Channel, Time) %>%
  group_modify( ~ {
    df <- .x
    
    lm_red <- lm(Amplitude ~ Covariate, data = df)
    
    df$Y_hat_red <- fitted(lm_red)
    df$resid_red <- residuals(lm_red)
    
    df
  }) %>%
  ungroup()

for (p in seq_len(nPerm)) {
  perm_dat <- FL_parts %>%
    group_by(Channel, Time) %>%
    group_modify( ~ {
      df <- .x
      perm_idx <- sample(seq_len(length(unique(dat$Subject))))
      ## Freedman-Lane permuted response
      df$Amplitude <- df$Y_hat_red + df$resid_red[perm_idx]
      
      df
    }) %>%
    ungroup()
  
  t_perm <- compute_tmap_covariate(perm_dat)
  
  TFCE_perm <- tfce_transform(t_perm, E  = 0.66, H  = 2, dh = 0.1)
  
  TFCE_permMax[p] <- max(abs(TFCE_perm), na.rm = TRUE)
  
  if (p %% 50 == 0) {
    cat("Permutation", p, "of", nPerm, "\n")
  }
}

cat("Permutation testing completed.\n")

## ==========================================================
## Step 4: TFCE-corrected significance
## ==========================================================

cat("Step 4: Computing TFCE-corrected significance...\n")

alpha <- 0.05

maxTFCE <- sort(c(TFCE_permMax, max(abs(TFCE_Obs), na.rm = TRUE)))

maxTFCEcrit <- maxTFCE[round(nPerm * (1 - alpha))]

Mask <- abs(TFCE_Obs) >= maxTFCEcrit

P_Values <- matrix(NA,
                   nrow = nChan,
                   ncol = nTime,
                   dimnames = dimnames(TFCE_Obs))

for (ch in seq_len(nChan)) {
  for (t in seq_len(nTime)) {
    P_Values[ch, t] <-
      (sum(TFCE_permMax >= abs(TFCE_Obs[ch, t]), na.rm = TRUE) + 1) /
      (nPerm + 1)
  }
}

cat("TFCE-corrected significance completed.\n")
cat(sprintf("Critical TFCE value = %.4f\n", maxTFCEcrit))

## ==========================================================
## Step 5: Store results
## ==========================================================

cat("Step 5: Storing results...\n")

Results <- list(
  Obs          = t_Obs,
  TFCE_Obs     = TFCE_Obs,
  TFCE_Null    = TFCE_permMax,
  maxTFCEcrit  = maxTFCEcrit,
  P_Values     = P_Values,
  Mask         = Mask,
  alpha        = alpha,
  nPerm        = nPerm,
  model        = "Amplitude ~ Covariate + GroupCode",
  test         = "Group effect adjusted for covariate",
  times        = times,
  channels     = channels
)

cat("Results stored.\n")

## ==========================================================
## Step 6: Plot significant effects
## ==========================================================

mT <- t_Obs
mT[!Mask] <- 0

plot_eeg_map(mT, "TFCE-corrected Group Effect Adjusted for Covariate", times, nChan)

## ==========================================================
## Step 7: Plot observed TFCE values
## ==========================================================

plot_eeg_map(TFCE_Obs, "Observed TFCE Map: Group Effect Adjusted for Covariate", times, nChan)

## ==========================================================
## Step 8: Save results
## ==========================================================

if (!dir.exists("../results")) {
  dir.create("../results")
}

save(Results, file = "../results/02_TFCE_between_subject_covariate_results.RData")

cat("TFCE covariate-adjusted between-subject analysis completed.\n")
cat("Saved results: ../results/02_TFCE_between_subject_covariate_results.RData\n")
```
